header: Features, each with its current status
lead: Shipped, in progress or planned, shown as a list. Use it for a public roadmap; use the included checklist when the status is only yes or no.
note: States are a snapshot, not a promise: the list changes as plans do.

items.title: Editors write the state word
items.text: It appears as a badge and can be written in any language.

items.title: The dot follows a switch
items.text: The colour comes from the shipped switch, not from the word, so the two never contradict each other.

items.title: Unshipped rows step back
items.text: Their titles use the secondary colour, so readers notice what has shipped first.

items.title: Two to fifteen entries
items.text: Past fifteen, a roadmap reads better split into one list per quarter.
